verdict.rationale: Render's own docs state that you connect a repo and ship with every push, which is the story's exact capability. Its ephemeral previews for every change further support a Git-driven deploy workflow. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of auto-deploy configuration (branch selection, toggling auto-deploy, build triggers), independent or hands-on corroboration of push-triggered deploys.

support.subject: As a developer, I can automatically deploy my app on every Git push

citations.quote: Connect your repo and ship with every push.
Iterate quickly with ephemeral previews of your entire application architecture for every change.
